blocks.text: AI is a computer program that has read a huge amount of text and learned to chat with people. Claude is one of these AIs.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.
How does it know the answers?
Imagine a friend who has read a million books. When you ask something, they remember what they read and put an answer together. AI works in a similar way – just much faster.

items: Explain a school lesson in an easier way
Make up a story or a joke
Help you make a study plan
Answer questions when you're curious about something

blocks.text: AI isn't always right! If something matters, check it with a teacher or a parent. And never give it personal info like your address or passwords.
New tip: didn't understand the answer? Write "Explain it like I'm 10" and the AI will make it easier!
Explain how volcanoes work as if I'm 12 years old.
